what_it_does: This paper presents a 3D Flash memory chip (a trillion bits, storing 3 bits per cell) designed for AI workloads. The chip makes two key improvements to existing designs: first, it reads data more efficiently by using smaller voltage swings when accessing the memory cells, reducing wasted energy by 29 percent. Second, it adds high-speed I/O interfaces (input/output ports) that are isolated from the main power supply to prevent electrical noise, allowing data to flow at 4.8 gigabits per second. The isolation also shrinks the circuit overhead around the memory array, making the chip smaller. Together, these optimizations make the memory both faster and more power-efficient for AI applications.
